message: Right guard and right headlight damaged

steps: Found new and used right LED headlights
Checked fittings for guard and headlight

lines.reason_short: Right front guard fits all Corolla trims.
lines.reason_long: The right guard is damaged and this one fits every trim. It is over $150, so it needs your confirmation.

lines.reason_short: New and used right LED headlights both fit.
lines.reason_long: Both fit the ZR. The used one is cheaper but cannot be returned.
lines.question: New or used right headlight?

lines.reason_short: Mounting bracket is often damaged with the headlight.
lines.reason_long: A new headlight is going on, and the bracket is cheap and returnable. Check the old one for cracks.

lines.reason_short: Right wheel-arch liner may be damaged with the guard.
lines.reason_long: Guard damage often cracks the liner behind it. Check it when the guard is off.

result.reply: I suggested the right guard and a couple of small parts. Pick new or used for the right headlight.
